name: Visitor Recognizer
tagline: Know familiar faces at your door
shortDescription: Know which registered, consenting visitors are at your door. Works with Ring.
description: Visitor Recognizer tells you when someone you know arrives. Register trusted visitors who have agreed to it, then get a named alert when they show up on your Ring doorbell or camera. Face matching runs on Visitor Recognizer's secure cloud service (hosted on Render in the US), not on your phone. Every visitor record, face template and snapshot is encrypted at rest, consent is recorded for each registration, opt-out deletes a person's face template immediately, and arrival events delete automatically after 30 days. Visitor Recognizer is an independent app by Aoi Corp and is not made or endorsed by Ring.
privacy: Face templates, visitor names, photos, consent records and event snapshots are processed and stored server-side on the app's Render-hosted service, encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Events auto-delete after 30 days; visitor data is deleted on opt-out or owner request. No data is sold or shared.
features: Named arrival alerts for registered visitors
One-tap opt-out that deletes the face template
Encrypted storage of all visitor data
Export or delete all data at any time
requirements: At least one Ring doorbell or camera
